title: Transport a Zariski-open lift to normalized etale tensor sections
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], a module morphism ψ : G → H, an etale object u : U → X, an open V in U, a global section s of u^*H and a section t of u^*G on V with (u^*ψ)(t) = s|V, there is a section z of (V → U → X)^*G on the whole open subscheme V whose image under (V → X)^*ψ equals the normalized tensor restriction of s. Tensor sections and their restrictions are [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial]. There is no epi, quasi-coherence or covering assumption.

source.place: Equation (35.8.0.1), with pullback adjunction Tag 0096 and restriction along open immersions

proof.text: By uniqueness of left adjoints, compare tensor pullback along V.ι with Mathlib restrictFunctor V.ι. Identify global sections of the restricted module with sections over V using V.ι_image_top. Naturality of the comparison commutes with ψ; the unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app equation identifies the restriction of a global section followed by this comparison with tensorSectionsUnit.

Apply the comparison to t, then apply tensorSectionsComp V.ι U.hom on global sections. Naturality of tensorSectionsComp and the preceding naturality equation turn its image into the comparison of s|V, which is the normalized tensor restriction of s by the unit equation. This gives z and the required equality.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleTensorSections_open_lift {X : Scheme.{u}} {G H : X.Modules}
    (ψ : G ⟶ H) (U : X.Etale) (V : U.left.Opens)
    (s : Γ((tensorPullback U.hom).obj H, ⊤))
    (t : Γ((tensorPullback U.hom).obj G, V))
    (ht : ((tensorPullback U.hom).map ψ).app V t =
      ((tensorPullback U.hom).obj H).presheaf.map (homOfLE (show V ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op s) :
    ∃ z : Γ((tensorPullback (V.ι ≫ U.hom)).obj G, ⊤),
      ((tensorPullback (V.ι ≫ U.hom)).map ψ).app ⊤ z =
        etaleTensorSectionsRestriction H
          (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk V.ι rfl : Scheme.Etale.mk (V.ι ≫ U.hom) ⟶ U) s
